subject: general
question: In which of the following events did India win a gold medal in the Summer Olympics 2020 (played in 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is __Javelin throw__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• At the Tokyo Olympics, Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in the men's javelin throw division.
 
• After Abhinav Bindra, he is the only other Indian to win an individual Olympic medal.
 
• Neeraj also captured the nation's first gold medal in the sport of athletics and India's first medal in the sport since independence.
 
• Neeraj Chopra:-
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra is an Indian track and field athlete who is the reigning Olympic champion and world championship silver medalist in the javelin throw.
 
• He is the first Asian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal in the men's javelin throw.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Olympics is an international multi-sportings event.
 
• It is held once every four years.
 
• It includes several countries' selected players as participants.
 
• The Olympic logo consists of five rings and one icon of the place where it is held Blue, yellow, black, green, and red is the order of the color of the Olympic logo rings.
 
• It represents five continents: Asia, Africa, America, Australia, and Europe.
